name: wavedb-monorepo
description: WaveDB — a concurrent-write embedded relational database for TypeScript (Node + Bun)

scripts.build: bun run build:native && tsc -p packages/wavedb/tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p packages/wave-cli/tsconfig.build.json && bun run test:studio
scripts.test: bun run test:rust && bun run test:ts && bun run test:studio && bun run test:node
scripts.test:ts: bun run build:native && bun test packages/wavedb/test packages/wave-cli/test
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/wavedb/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/wave-cli/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/wave-studio/tsconfig.json --noEmit
